name: Araknis
description: Monitor and control PoE on up to 16 Araknis 310-series managed switches. Hierarchical switch, PoE summary, and port nodes with power monitoring, link status, and independent polling.
notice: Configure Switch 1 using host, username, and password. Additional switches use host2, username2, password2 through host16, username16, password16. Each switch has its own parent node containing its PoE summary and ports.
